content.text:
This looks correct and consistent. Note: the `document.documentElement` reference in the head script runs before `<body>` exists, which is fine since it only sets a dataset attribute on `<html>`.

Added a manual light/dark theme toggle button in the nav that persists the user's choice in `localStorage` (falling back to system preference), applied instantly via an inline head script to avoid a flash of the wrong theme, and adjusted the nav layout to a flex row so the toggle sits at the right edge.

result:
This looks correct and consistent. Note: the `document.documentElement` reference in the head script runs before `<body>` exists, which is fine since it only sets a dataset attribute on `<html>`.

Added a manual light/dark theme toggle button in the nav that persists the user's choice in `localStorage` (falling back to system preference), applied instantly via an inline head script to avoid a flash of the wrong theme, and adjusted the nav layout to a flex row so the toggle sits at the right edge.
